label: Whatever is not MOTION_3 held as to being is PURE_ACT_1
paraphrase: Conclusion: whatever is not MOTION_3 held as to being (definition ea1904bc-bdfa-4835-a4a7-8545c5221e2e at the respect esse: it is not the case both that it is in act as to being and that something other than it presently actualizes it as to being) is in POTENCY_1 in no respect (PureAct of adopted potency, DEF-PURE-ACT, DEF-POTENCY). The antecedent also holds of whatever in the domain is not in act as to being, so the claim covers those items too. A fortiori a holder unheld in every respect is PURE_ACT_1. It is a claim about every item of the domain, not only about holders.
